svg.data-environment: Ubuntu 24.04 · AMD EPYC 9V74 (4 vCPU) · GCC 13.3.0 · Release (-O3, NDEBUG)
svg.title: Paired phase-1 deny benchmark
svg.desc: 12 paired round aggregates compare intervention log payload enabled and disabled. Payload disabled had a lower sample mean in 12 rounds. The median enabled-minus-disabled difference was 5.541 microseconds per transaction; its exact 96.1 percent order-statistic interval was 5.517 to 6.157 microseconds.

cc:Work.dc:title: Paired phase-1 deny benchmark
cc:Work.dc:description: 12 paired rounds; 50,000 transactions per aggregate. Median paired difference 5.541 microseconds per transaction; exact 96.1 percent interval 5.517 to 6.157 microseconds.
